name: Test Hello World
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: fwilhe2/setup-kotlin@v1
      - run: kotlinc Main.kt -include-runtime -d Main.jar
      - run: test "$(java -jar Main.jar)" = "Hello, World!"
